title: Word Formation: Od czasownika do rzeczownika (krok 1: koncowki)

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij kazde zdanie jednym wyrazem, przeksztalcajac wyraz podany wielkimi literami obok luki. Wymagana jest calkowita poprawnosc ortograficzna. W tym cwiczeniu wystarczy dodac koncowke - zaden wyraz nie potrzebuje przedrostka.

items.sentence: The city needs better __________ if it wants to solve these problems.
After years of __________, she finally won her first medal.
The old bridge is closed for __________ until the end of May.
The __________ of the factory cost hundreds of workers their jobs.
This __________ could change the way we travel forever.
The storm caused serious __________ to the train timetable.
Wearing a helmet gives you good __________ against head injuries.
Air __________ in big cities is getting worse every year.
